purpose: post-test prompt sensitivity on the same 40 frozen games
input: unchanged anonymous replay and controlled checks from blind-v7; no manifest or gold labels
output: one game-level harness, weights, or controller attribution, or uncertain abstention; no decision index
primary_measure: correct class among 30 technically verified edited-fault games
paired_comparison: probe minus read accuracy on the same games; stratify bootstrap resampling by changed layer
controls: report unsupported harness/controller calls on 10 no-injection losses separately
interpretation_limit: Prompt selected after prior 40-game answers were inspected; sensitivity analysis only, not a new independent confirmation.
